paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the gradient norm of the preference model during training. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step" and represents a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to approximately 1200, marked with tick intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Gradient Norm" and represents a linear scale with values ranging from approximately 0 to 800, marked with tick intervals of 100. A single line, colored blue and displayed as a solid line, traces the gradient norm of the preference model across the training steps, beginning at a value of approximately 0 at Training Step 0 and reaching a peak value of approximately 750 at Training Step 600, subsequently decreasing to approximately 10 at Training Step 1200.
